differences.name: turn-persona
differences.reason: AR p75 explicitly includes persona in per-turn uniqueness limits. Pinned GEMP RecordCardsBeingPlayedEffect and CardTraits only record/check titles. Native applies the rulebook restriction; this is not claimed as GEMP parity.

scope: Production table/out-of-play uniqueness queries and RecordCardsBeingPlayedEffect per-turn counters. Controlled placements and direct production recording are mechanism fixtures, not complete deployment, cancellation or return-card plays. Native runtime tests separately cover deployment, persistence, revival and pending-result revalidation.
references: AR p49: persona versions on table; each owner may have a different titled version.
AR p75: unique/restricted table and per-turn limits, including canceled plays, and shared title limits across players.
Pinned GEMP CardTraits, RecordCardsBeingPlayedEffect, Uniqueness enum and explicit constructor addPersona/addPersonas metadata.
limits: Ordinary current metadata only. Dynamic uniqueness/persona changes, compound titles/permanent personas, capturing/stolen control, replacement, special conversion and diamond system restrictions remain unfinished. Metadata-only characters are not admitted. Legacy native component snapshots without a ledger default to no previous plays; no production native full matches are admitted. Full card/deck admission remains closed.
